prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Pleasanton CA?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — do you mean spray (airbrush/solution) tanning or UV tanning (tanning beds/booths)? “Best” depends on which service you want plus your location, budget and safety preferences.

If you want a quick answer: tell me which tanning type you prefer and any constraints (near downtown Pleasanton, price range, evening hours, etc.) and I’ll give tailored recommendations and what to look for.

If you want to decide on your own, here are quick tips for choosing the best salon:
- Know the service: spray tans give an instant, UV-free bronze and are safest for skin; UV beds give a more gradual tan but increase skin-cancer risk.  
- Check recent reviews: Google Maps, Yelp and Facebook pages show real customer feedback and photos. Look for consistently high ratings and recent posts.  
- Cleanliness & equipment: salons should maintain clean booths/tables, provide disposable liners/gowns, and use modern, well-maintained beds or spray equipment.  
- Technician training: for spray tans, ask whether techs are certified and which solution brands they use (look for reputable brands that match your skin tone).  
- Pricing & packages: compare single sessions vs. packages/memberships; some salons offer first-time specials.  
- Safety & policies: for UV tanning, confirm eye protection, session time controls, and a skin assessment before first use. For spray tan, ask about patch tests for allergies.  
- Photos and sample results: ask for before/after photos for clients with skin tones like yours.  
- Cancellation/retouch policies: important if you need a quick event tan or touch-ups.

If you want, tell me which type you prefer and your neighborhood/zip code and I’ll recommend a few top-rated salons and draft questions to call or message them.
